課程綱要.開課單位: 應用地質研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程目標: 使學生熟悉岩石力學之基本學理，內容涵蓋應力、應變分析與組成律、岩體構造與岩體分類、岩石、節理及岩體力學特性以及岩體現地應力量測。
課程綱要.授課內容:
1彈性力學基礎觀念(4 hr)
1.1應力分析
1.2應變分析
1.3組成律
2認識岩體構造(8 hr)
2.1不連續面特性描述
2.2立體投影分析
2.3岩體分類
3岩體力學特性(17 hr)
3.1岩石室內力學試驗
3.2岩石破壞準則 (均向性及異向性)
3.3節理強度與變形性
3.4岩體材料之力學行為
岩石單壓試驗
4岩體現地應力(6 hr)
4.1影響現地應力之相關因素介紹
4.2現地應力量測
岩石力學相關研究文獻選讀(9 hr)
課程綱要.教科書/參考書:
“Bray, B.H..G., and E.T. Brown, Rock mechanics for underground mining, 2nd ed, Chapman and Hall, London, 1993.
Goodman, R.E. Introduction to rock mechanics, 2nd ed, John Wiley and Sons,1989.“
課程綱要.評量配分比重:
隨堂考試或作業20％
期中考30％
文獻選讀報告10％
期末考30％
上課討論狀況10％
課程綱要.課程領域: 基礎學科 、 地質災害

課程綱要.開課單位: 應用地質研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(中文): 構造地質學及地質模型建置特論
課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Special topics on structural geology and geological modeling
課程綱要.課程目標: Audience: Graduate students with a (strong) background in structural geology, motivated to strengthen their skills for research/professional goals  Objectives: - Strengthen background and general skills in structural geology - Learn practical applications of structural geology in various fields of interest via the utilization of a designated software
課程綱要.授課內容:
This course is designed for graduate students with a strong background in structural geology and willing to strengthen their skills and learn how to use a structural geology software for research or professional applications.
At the beginning of the semester, students will design their own project based on their research goals or the skill they wish to gain, and choose the tools they want to use accordingly. Learning will be self-driven, each student working on his/her own project, guided by the instructor. Regular progress presentations will allow everyone to share their progress and the challenges met, so that everyone can learn from others’ projects.
- List of potential applications: 1. Draw and restore geological cross-sections. 2. Build a 2D/3D geological model, 3. Invert stress field based on strain observations, 4. Analyze a seismic line. 5. … and any other applications that you may be interested in
- List of possible software to utilise: MOVE Suite, Rockworks, StructureSolver, … or a software of your suggestion.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Classical textbooks on structural geology, rock mechanics, geological modeling may be used as support if needed.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Grading will be based on the level of difficulty and ambition of the project, the performance during the project development, the presentations quality and the participation during presentations
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: Independent learning and practical works adapted to students progress and chosen projects
課程綱要.課程領域: 基礎學科 、 地質災害

課程名稱(英文): Special topic on numerical groundwater modeling
備註: 英語授課

課程綱要.開課單位: 應用地質研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Special topic on numerical groundwater modeling
課程綱要.課程目標: This course focuses on advanced numerical modeling of groundwater flow and transport problems. The topics cover the fundamentals of numerical analysis, the concept of different numerical methods, the stability analysis for developed models. Students in this class will learn a number of numerical models that are relative to groundwater flow and transport. Procedures to create conceptual model and interpretation of modeling results will be discussed through case studies.
課程綱要.授課內容:
1. Why groundwater flow and transport model?
2. The numerical models for groundwater flow and contaminant transport
3. Elements for development of conceptual models for groundwater modeling
4. Numerical stability issues for numerical discretization
5. Calibration and validation issues
6. Inverse modeling, sensitivity and uncertainty analysis
7. Case study
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Anderson M.P. and Woessner W.W, (2015), Applied Groundwater Modeling-Simulation of Flow and Advective Transport, Academic Press. Wang H.F. and Anderson M.P.(1982), Introduction to Groundwater Modeling, Academic Press. Bear J. Cheng H.D. A., (2010) Modeling Groundwater Flow and Contaminant Transport (Theory and Applications of Transport in Porous Media, Springer.
